description: Self-contained contenteditable paragraph. Owns its JS keyboard-handler lifecycle and surfaces high-level EventCallbacks so the parent dispatcher can react. The [JSInvokable] method names must match the strings used in notion-editor.js. EventCallback parameter names are distinct from those method names to avoid C# conflicts.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Fired after Enter splits the block. Arg = HTML fragment after the split point.

parameters.name: OnEnterSplit
parameters.description: Fired on blur when the HTML has changed. Arg = new HTML.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Fired when a markdown pattern is recognised. Arg = shortcut key (e.g. "heading1").

parameters.name: OnIndentChange
parameters.description: Fired when Backspace is pressed on an empty block.

parameters.name: OnMentionMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '/' is typed in a trigger position. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnMoveFocusNext
parameters.description: Fired when ArrowUp requests focus movement to the previous block.

parameters.name: OnMoveFocusPrevious
parameters.description: Fired when the element receives focus.

parameters.name: OnPageLinkMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '@' mention syntax is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnSlashMenu
parameters.description: Fired when ArrowDown requests focus movement to the next block.

parameters.name: OnTokenMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '[[' page-link syntax is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnTypeConvert
parameters.description: Fired when Tab / Shift+Tab is pressed. Bool = shiftKey (true = outdent).
